source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 18 (PDF 118-136), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Quantum Physics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Quantum theory assumes that electromagnetic radiation behaves as:
(Quantum theory ke mutabiq electromagnetic radiation kis tarah bartao karti hai?)

options.text: aisa yaksaan field jis mein energy na ho

blocks.explanation: Quantum theory electromagnetic radiation ko energy ke alag alag packets (discrete packets) maanti hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Quantum Theory assumes the behaviour of electromagnetic radiations as discrete packets of energy

blocks.prompt:
2 According to the chapter, classical physics:
(Chapter ke mutabiq classical physics ke baare mein kya durust hai?)

options.text: sirf atoms ke andar durust hai
rozmarra zindagi ke aam amal mein ab bhi durust hai
sirf roshni par lagu hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Classical physics rozmarra ke aam amal mein ab bhi durust hai; bohat chhote paimane par quantum theory chahiye (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: the classical physics is still valid in ordinary processes of everyday life

blocks.prompt:
3 Max Planck suggested that energy is radiated or absorbed:
(Max Planck ne kya tajweez kiya ke energy kis tarah kharij ya jazb hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Planck ke mutabiq energy musalsal wave ki bajaye alag alag packets (quanta) mein kharij ya jazb hoti hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: In 1901, Max Planck suggested that energy is radiated or absorbed in discrete packets of energy called quanta

blocks.prompt:
4 A quantum is:
(Quantum kya hai?)

options.text: rest mass wala maadde ka zarra

blocks.explanation: Quanta, quantum ki jama hai; quantum energy ka aik alag packet hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: Quanta is plural of quantum, a discrete packet of energy.

blocks.prompt:
5 Each quantum is associated with radiation of:
(Har quantum kis radiation se wabasta hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har quantum aik hi frequency (tadad-e-irtiaash) ki radiation se wabasta hai, aur us ki energy E = hf hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: Each quantum is associated with radiations of a single frequency.

blocks.prompt:
6 The value of Planck's constant h is:
(Planck's constant h ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Planck's constant h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s (18.1).

book_ref.quote: where h is Planck's constant, its value is 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the energy of one quantum of radiation of frequency 6 × 10¹⁴ Hz?
(6 × 10¹⁴ Hz frequency wali radiation ke aik quantum ki energy kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The energy E of each quantum is proportional to its frequency f related as

blocks.prompt:
8 Two photons have wavelengths 400 nm and 800 nm. The ratio of their energies E₄₀₀ : E₈₀₀ is:
(Do photons ki wavelengths 400 nm aur 800 nm hain. Un ki energies ki nisbat E₄₀₀ : E₈₀₀ kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = hc/λ, is liye E ∝ 1/λ. Wavelength aadhi ho to energy dugni: E₄₀₀ : E₈₀₀ = 2 : 1 (18.1).

book_ref.quote: The energy E of each quantum is proportional to its frequency f related as

blocks.prompt:
9 Max Planck received the Nobel Prize in physics for his discovery of energy quanta in:
(Max Planck ko energy quanta ki daryaft par physics ka Nobel Prize kis saal mila?)
blocks.explanation: Planck ko 1918 mein Nobel Prize mila (18.1). 1921 Einstein, 1927 Compton, 1932 Heisenberg.

book_ref.quote: Max Planck received Nobel Prize in physics in 1918 for his discovery of energy quanta.

blocks.prompt:
10 Which constant is described in the chapter as a constant of the special theory of relativity?
(Chapter mein kaun sa constant special theory of relativity ka constant kaha gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: h quantum theory ka constant hai aur c (roshni ki raftaar) special relativity ka constant hai (18.1, box).

book_ref.quote: another important constant c is the speed of light c which is a constant of special theory of relativity

blocks.prompt:
11 Einstein called the indivisible tiny bundles of energy of electromagnetic radiation:
(Einstein ne electromagnetic radiation ki energy ke na-taqseem (indivisible) chhote bundles ko kya naam diya?)
blocks.explanation: Einstein ne in na-taqseem bundles ko photons kaha; roshni ki beam photons ki dhaar hai jo c raftaar se chalti hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: These indivisible tiny bundles of energy he called

blocks.prompt:
12 Planck assumed that the particle nature of radiation from hot bodies was due to:
(Planck ne garam ajsaam se nikalne wali radiation ki zarrati (particle) fitrat ki wajah kya maani?)

options.text: radiation paida karne wale atoms ki koi khaasiyat
garam jism ki satah ka rang

blocks.explanation: Planck ne maana ke yeh zarrati fitrat radiation paida karne wale atoms ki kisi khaasiyat ki wajah se hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: He assumed that granular or particle nature of radiation from hot bodies was due to some property of the atoms producing it.

blocks.prompt:
13 The energy E and momentum p of a photon are related by:
(Photon ki energy E aur momentum p ka aapas mein kya rishta hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = mc² aur p = mc se E = pc milta hai (Eq. 18.2).

book_ref.quote: From the theory of relativity E = mc², the relativistic momentum of photon is; p = mc,

blocks.prompt:
14 The momentum of a photon of wavelength λ is:
(λ wavelength wale photon ka momentum kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: pc = hf se p = hf/c; c = fλ hai is liye p = h/λ (Eq. 18.3). hc/λ energy hai, momentum nahi.

book_ref.quote: From the theory of relativity E = mc², the relativistic momentum of photon is; p = mc,

blocks.prompt:
15 What is the momentum of a photon of wavelength 663 nm?
(663 nm wavelength wale photon ka momentum kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The beam of light with wavelength λ consists of a stream of photons travelling at speed c and carries energy; E = hf.

blocks.prompt:
16 Quantum theory can be extended to a mass oscillating on a spring, but its particle nature is not seen because:
(Spring par jhoolte mass par bhi quantum theory lagu ho sakti hai, magar us ki zarrati fitrat nazar kyun nahi aati?)

options.text: us ki energy quantized hi nahi
bare ajsaam ke liye h zero hai
woh kaafi tez harkat nahi karta
us ke energy steps itne chhote hain ke pakde nahi ja sakte

blocks.explanation: Aise nizam ke energy steps itne chhote hain ke maloom hi nahi ho sakte, is liye zarrati fitrat nazar nahi aati (18.1).

book_ref.quote: However, energy steps are far too small to be detected, so any particle nature is invisible.

blocks.prompt:
17 Quantum effects are important only when observing:
(Quantum asraat sirf kab ahem hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Quantum asraat sirf atom jitne chhote ajsaam ke liye ahem hain, jahan h ka asar maloom kiya ja sakta hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: Quantum effects are only important when observing atom sized objects

blocks.prompt:
18 The photoelectric effect is the emission of:
(Photoelectric effect kis cheez ka ikhraaj (emission) hai?)

options.text: garam karne par dhaat se roshni
munasib frequency ki roshni parne par dhaat ki satah se electrons
roshni parne par dhaat se protons
sirf surkh garam dhaat se electrons

blocks.explanation: Photoelectric effect: munasib frequency ki roshni parne par dhaat ki satah se electrons ka nikalna (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The process of emission of electrons from a metal surface when exposed to light of suitable frequency or wavelength is called the photoelectric effect.

blocks.prompt:
19 The electrons emitted in the photoelectric effect are called:
(Photoelectric effect mein nikalne wale electrons kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nikalne wale electrons photoelectrons kehlate hain (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The emitted electrons are known as photoelectrons.

blocks.prompt:
20 In the apparatus of Fig. 18.1, monochromatic light of suitable frequency is made to shine on:
(Fig. 18.1 ke apparatus mein munasib frequency ki monochromatic roshni kis par daali jati hai?)

options.text: negative terminal se juda cathode C

blocks.explanation: Negative terminal se juda electrode C cathode hai; us par roshni parne se electrons nikal kar positive anode ki taraf jate hain (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The metal electrode C connected to negative terminal acts as cathode.

blocks.prompt:
21 In the photoelectric experiment the photoelectric current is measured by a:
(Photoelectric tajurbe mein photoelectric current kis se napi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photoelectrons positive anode ki taraf khinchte hain aur current micro-ammeter se napi jati hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: These photoelectrons are attracted by the positive anode and the resulting current is measured by a micro-ammeter.

blocks.prompt:
22 In the photoelectric experiment the current stops as soon as the light is cut off. This proves that:
(Roshni band karte hi current ruk jati hai. Is se kya sabit hota hai?)

options.text: current girne wali roshni ki wajah se behti hai

blocks.explanation: Roshni band hone par current ruk jati hai, is liye current roshni ki wajah se hai; isay photoelectric current kehte hain (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The current stops when light is cut off, which proves that the current flows because of incident light.

blocks.prompt:
23 The stopping potential V₀ in the photoelectric experiment is:
(Photoelectric tajurbe mein stopping potential V₀ kya hai?)

options.text: woh positive potential jis par current zyada se zyada ho
anode ka woh negative potential jis par photoelectric current zero ho jaye
woh potential jis par electrons pehli baar cathode chhorte hain
roshni band hone par battery ka potential

blocks.explanation: Connections ulat kar anode ko zyada negative kiya jata hai; stopping potential V₀ par sab se tez electrons bhi nahi pahunchte aur current zero ho jati hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: at a certain value, called stopping potential V₀, the current becomes zero

blocks.prompt:
24 The stopping potential for a metal surface is 1.5 V. The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons is:
(Aik dhaat ki satah ka stopping potential 1.5 V hai. Photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The maximum kinetic energy of photoelectrons is, thus

blocks.prompt:
25 Light of the same frequency but higher intensity falls on the cathode. Then:
(Usi frequency magar zyada intensity (shiddat) ki roshni cathode par parti hai. To kya hoga?)

options.text: current wahi, stopping potential barhta hai
current barhti hai magar stopping potential wahi rehta hai
current aur stopping potential dono barhte hain

blocks.explanation: Zyada intensity se current barhti hai magar current usi V₀ par rukti hai (Fig. 18.2) (18.2).

book_ref.quote: If the experiment is repeated with light beam of higher intensity, the amount of current increases but the current stops for the same value of V₀.

blocks.prompt:
26 Intensity is kept constant and the frequency of incident light is changed. The curves of Fig. 18.3 show that:
(Intensity qaim rakh kar roshni ki frequency badli jaye to Fig. 18.3 ke curves kya dikhate hain?)

options.text: har frequency ka stopping potential aik jaisa
current wahi magar har frequency ka stopping potential alag
current barhti hai, stopping potential nahi badalta

blocks.explanation: Qaim intensity par current wahi rehti hai magar har frequency ka V₀ alag hai; yani (K.E.)max frequency par munhasir hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The current is same but stopping potential is different for each frequency of incident light

blocks.prompt:
27 The maximum energy of photoelectrons depends on:
(Photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada energy kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: dhaat ki satah aur roshni ki frequency

blocks.explanation: (K.E.)max dhaat ki satah aur roshni ki frequency par munhasir hai, intensity par nahi (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The maximum energy of photoelectrons depends on the particular metal surface and the frequency of incident light.

blocks.prompt:
28 Threshold frequency is the:
(Threshold frequency kya hai?)

options.text: dhaat ki jazb ki ja sakne wali zyada se zyada frequency
jis frequency par current sab se zyada ho
jis frequency par intensity zero ho
woh kam se kam frequency jis se neeche koi electron nahi nikalta

blocks.explanation: Threshold frequency se kam par koi electron nahi nikalta, roshni kitni hi tez kyun na ho (18.2).

book_ref.quote: There is a minimum frequency called threshold frequency below which no electrons are emitted

blocks.prompt:
29 When red light and blue light fall on sodium metal (Fig. 18.4):
(Sodium dhaat par surkh aur neeli roshni parti hai (Fig. 18.4). Kya hota hai?)

options.text: neeli roshni electrons nikalti hai, surkh nahi

blocks.explanation: Neeli roshni sodium se electrons nikalti hai, surkh roshni (threshold se kam frequency) nahi (18.2).

book_ref.quote: For example, blue light produces photoelectric emission in sodium metal but red light does not

blocks.prompt:
30 The threshold frequency f₀:
(Threshold frequency f₀ ke baare mein kya durust hai?)

options.text: tamaam dhaaton ke liye aik jaisi
har dhaat ke liye alag hoti hai

blocks.explanation: f₀ har dhaat ke liye alag hai (18.2), kyun ke har dhaat ka apna work function hai, φ = hf₀.

book_ref.quote: This threshold frequency f₀ varies from metal to metal.

blocks.prompt:
31 In the photoelectric effect, the intensity of light (above threshold) determines:
(Photoelectric effect mein (threshold se upar) roshni ki intensity kis cheez ka faisla karti hai?)

options.text: electrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy
sirf nikalne wale electrons ki tadad

blocks.explanation: Electrons foran nikalte hain aur intensity sirf un ki tadad tay karti hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: Electrons are emitted instantaneously; the intensity of light determines only their number.

blocks.prompt:
32 Photoelectric emission from a metal takes place only if the wavelength of the incident light is:
(Dhaat se photoelectric emission sirf kab hota hai jab roshni ki wavelength:)

options.text: threshold wavelength ki bilkul dugni ho

blocks.explanation: Emission ke liye f > f₀ chahiye; c = fλ se zyada frequency ka matlab chhoti wavelength, is liye λ threshold wavelength se chhoti ho (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The corresponding wavelength of incident light is called threshold wavelength.

blocks.prompt:
33 According to the electromagnetic wave theory of light, increasing the intensity of the incident light should:
(Roshni ki electromagnetic wave theory ke mutabiq intensity barhane se kya hona chahiye?)

options.text: nikalne wale electrons ki tadad kam honi chahiye
nikalne wale electrons ki kinetic energy barhni chahiye

blocks.explanation: Wave theory ke mutabiq zyada intensity se K.E. barhni chahiye, jo tajurbe ke khilaf hai; threshold frequency bhi wazeh nahi hoti (18.2).

book_ref.quote: According to this theory, increasing the intensity of incident light should increase the K.E. of emitted electrons

blocks.prompt:
34 The work function φ of a metal is the:
(Dhaat ka work function φ kya hai?)

options.text: photoelectron ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy
electron ko satah se nikalne ke liye kam se kam energy

blocks.explanation: Work function φ woh kam se kam energy hai jo electron ko dhaat ki satah se nikalne ke liye chahiye (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The electron needs a certain minimum energy called the work function φ to escape from the metal surface.

blocks.prompt:
35 Einstein's photoelectric equation is:
(Einstein ki photoelectric equation kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photon ki energy − work function = (K.E.)max, yani hf − φ = ½mv²max (Eq. 18.5).

book_ref.quote: This is known as Einstein's photoelectric equation.

blocks.prompt:
36 The work function φ and threshold frequency f₀ of a metal are related by:
(Dhaat ke work function φ aur threshold frequency f₀ ka rishta kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Threshold par (K.E.)max = 0, is liye hf₀ − φ = 0, yani φ = hf₀ (Eq. 18.6, book correction ke mutabiq f₀).

book_ref.quote: When (K.E.)max of the photoelectron is zero, the frequency f is equal to threshold frequency f₀

blocks.prompt:
37 All photoelectrons do not have the maximum kinetic energy because:
(Tamaam photoelectrons ki kinetic energy zyada se zyada kyun nahi hoti?)

options.text: kuch electrons do do photons jazb karte hain
roshni ki intensity waqt ke saath badalti hai
emission ke dauran work function badal jata hai
kuch electrons nikalne se pehle atomi takkaron mein energy kho dete hain

blocks.explanation: Kuch electrons seedhe nikalte hain, kuch atomi takkaron mein energy kho dete hain; Eq. 18.7 sirf poori zaid energy wale electrons par lagu hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: some electrons come straight out of the metal surface and some lose energy in atomic collisions before coming out

blocks.prompt:
38 Albert Einstein was awarded the Nobel Prize in physics in 1921 for his:
(Albert Einstein ko 1921 mein physics ka Nobel Prize kis kaam par mila?)
blocks.explanation: Einstein ko 1921 ka Nobel Prize photoelectric effect ki wazahat par mila (18.2).

book_ref.quote: Albert Einstein was awarded Nobel Prize in physics in 1921 for his explanation of photoelectric effect.

blocks.prompt:
39 The photoelectric effect can be explained only by assuming that light:
(Photoelectric effect sirf yeh maan kar wazeh hota hai ke roshni:)

options.text: aisi wave hai jis ki energy wavefront par yaksaan phaili ho
photons naami energy ke chhote packets par mushtamil hai

blocks.explanation: Agar energy wavefront par yaksaan phaili ho to yeh effect wazeh nahi hota; is ke liye photons chahiye, jo roshni ki zarrati fitrat dikhata hai (18.2).

book_ref.quote: Thus, it shows the particle nature of light.

blocks.prompt:
40 The work function of a metal is 2.0 eV. Its threshold frequency is:
(Aik dhaat ka work function 2.0 eV hai. Us ki threshold frequency kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: The electron needs a certain minimum energy called the work function φ to escape from the metal surface.

blocks.prompt:
41 The threshold wavelength of a metal of work function 3.0 eV is about:
(3.0 eV work function wali dhaat ki threshold wavelength taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: When (K.E.)max of the photoelectron is zero, the frequency f is equal to threshold frequency f₀

blocks.prompt:
42 Photons of energy 4.0 eV fall on a metal of work function 2.5 eV. The stopping potential is:
(4.0 eV energy wale photons 2.5 eV work function wali dhaat par parte hain. Stopping potential kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: A part of the photon energy is used by the electron to break away from the metal and the rest appears as the kinetic energy of the electron.

blocks.prompt:
43 Light of wavelength 400 nm falls on a metal of work function 2.0 eV. The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons is about:
(400 nm wavelength ki roshni 2.0 eV work function wali dhaat par parti hai. Photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: A part of the photon energy is used by the electron to break away from the metal and the rest appears as the kinetic energy of the electron.

blocks.prompt:
44 The energy of a photon of light of wavelength 500 nm is about:
(500 nm wavelength wali roshni ke photon ki energy taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = hc/λ = 3.98 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 2.49 eV (Example 18.1 ki tarah).

book_ref.quote: Find the energy of a photon in eV of the blue light of wavelength 450 nm.

blocks.prompt:
45 A graph of (K.E.)max of photoelectrons against the frequency f of light (Eq. 18.7) is a straight line whose slope is:
(Photoelectrons ki (K.E.)max aur roshni ki frequency f ka graph (Eq. 18.7) seedhi line hai. Us ka slope kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: (K.E.)max = hf − hf₀: f ke muqable mein yeh seedhi line hai jis ka slope h hai aur jo frequency axis ko f₀ par kaat'ti hai (Eq. 18.7).

book_ref.quote: Hence, we can also write Einstein's photoelectric equation as

blocks.prompt:
46 On the graph of (K.E.)max against light frequency, no photoemission occurs for frequencies:
((K.E.)max aur frequency ke graph par kin frequencies ke liye koi photoemission nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Threshold frequency f₀ se kam par koi photoemission nahi hota ('For your information' graph, 18.2).

book_ref.quote: Below a certain frequency fo, no photoemission occurs

blocks.prompt:
47 Photons of energy 2.6 eV eject electrons from a metal and the stopping potential is 0.6 V. The work function of the metal is:
(2.6 eV ke photons aik dhaat se electrons nikalte hain aur stopping potential 0.6 V hai. Dhaat ka work function kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: (K.E.)max = 0.6 eV; φ = 2.6 − 0.6 = 2.0 eV (Example 18.2 ki tarah).

book_ref.quote: Yellow light of 577 nm wavelength is incident on a cesium metal surface.

blocks.prompt:
48 When electromagnetic radiation of low energy (less than 0.5 MeV) interacts with matter, the dominant process is:
(Kam energy (0.5 MeV se kam) wali electromagnetic radiation jab maadde se milti hai to ghalib amal kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 0.5 MeV se kam par photoelectric effect, darmiyani energy par Compton effect, 1.2 MeV se upar pair production ghalib hai (box, 18.2).

book_ref.quote: (i) At low energies (less than 0.5 MeV), the dominant process is photoelectric effect.

blocks.prompt:
49 For photons of energy more than 1.2 MeV interacting with matter, the dominant process is:
(1.2 MeV se zyada energy wale photons ke liye maadde ke saath ghalib amal kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada energy (1.2 MeV se upar) par ghalib amal pair production hai (box, 18.2).

book_ref.quote: (iii) At higher energies (more than 1.2MeV), the dominant process is pair production.

blocks.prompt:
50 At intermediate photon energies, the dominant interaction of electromagnetic radiation with matter is:
(Darmiyani photon energies par electromagnetic radiation ka maadde se ghalib amal kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyani energies par ghalib amal Compton effect hai (box, 18.2).

book_ref.quote: (ii) At intermediate energies, the dominant process is Compton effect.

blocks.prompt:
51 In 1923 Compton studied the scattering of X-rays by:
(1923 mein Compton ne X-rays ka scattering (bikharna) kis se study kiya?)

options.text: graphite target ke dheele bandhe electrons

blocks.explanation: Compton ne graphite target ke dheele bandhe (loosely bound) electrons se X-rays ka scattering study kiya (18.3).

book_ref.quote: studied the scattering of X-rays by loosely bound electrons from a graphite target

blocks.prompt:
52 In the Compton effect, the wavelength of the scattered X-rays is:
(Compton effect mein bikhri hui X-rays ki wavelength kaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Compton ne dekha ke bikhri X-rays ki wavelength λs girne wali X-rays ki λi se zyada hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: He found that wavelength λs, of the scattered X-rays is larger than the wavelength λi of the incident X-rays.

blocks.prompt:
53 The increase in wavelength of scattered X-rays could NOT be explained on the basis of:
(Bikhri X-rays ki wavelength ka barhna kis ki bunyaad par wazeh NAHI ho saka?)
blocks.explanation: Wavelength ka barhna classical wave theory se wazeh nahi hua; Compton ne energy hc/λ aur momentum h/λ wale photons maane (18.3).

book_ref.quote: The increase in wavelength of scattered X-rays could not be explained on the basis of classical wave theory.

blocks.prompt:
54 To explain his result, Compton suggested that X-rays consist of photons with:
(Apne nateeje ki wazahat ke liye Compton ne X-ray photons ki kya energy aur momentum maane?)
blocks.explanation: Compton ke mutabiq X-rays photons hain jin ki energy hc/λ aur momentum h/λ hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: Compton suggested that X-rays consist of photons with energy hc/λ and momentum h/λ.

blocks.prompt:
55 In deriving the Compton shift, the collision of the X-ray photon with the electron is treated as:
(Compton shift nikalte waqt photon aur electron ke takraao ko kya maana jata hai?)

options.text: elastic takraao jis mein energy aur momentum dono conserved hain
inelastic takraao jis mein sirf momentum conserved
takraao jis mein sirf energy conserved
takraao jis mein koi bhi conserved nahi

blocks.explanation: Isay do gendon ke elastic takraao ki tarah liya jata hai; energy aur momentum dono mehfooz (conserved) rehte hain (18.3).

book_ref.quote: Actually this is simple problem of the elastic collision of two balls. Both energy and momentum are conserved.

blocks.prompt:
56 In the Compton effect, the kinetic energy of the recoiling electron is:
(Compton effect mein peeche hatne (recoil) wale electron ki kinetic energy kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electron ki K.E. = takraao ke baad kul energy (mc²) − pehle (m₀c²) = (m − m₀)c² (18.3).

book_ref.quote: with K.E. equal to (m − m₀)c²

blocks.prompt:
57 In the Compton derivation, momentum is conserved separately along x and y because:
(Compton derivation mein momentum x aur y rukh mein alag alag kyun conserve kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Momentum vector hai, is liye x aur y dono components mein conserve hona chahiye (18.3).

book_ref.quote: Since momentum is a vector quantity, it must be conserved both for x and y-components.

blocks.prompt:
58 The Compton shift in wavelength is given by:
(Compton shift ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Δλ = λ′ − λ = (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ) (Eq. 18.8).

book_ref.quote: Let us derive an expression for change in wavelength Δλ known as Compton shift in wavelength.

blocks.prompt:
59 The Compton wavelength h/m₀c of the electron has the value:
(Electron ki Compton wavelength h/m₀c ki qeemat kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: The factor h/m₀c has dimensions of wavelength and is called Compton wavelength and has the numerical value

blocks.prompt:
60 For X-rays scattered at θ = 90°, the Compton shift:
(θ = 90° par bikhri X-rays ke liye Compton shift kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 90° par cos θ = 0, is liye Δλ = h/m₀c, yani Compton wavelength (18.3).

book_ref.quote: If the scattered X-ray photons are observed at θ = 90°, the Compton shift Δλ equals the Compton wavelength.

blocks.prompt:
61 The Compton shift for X-rays scattered at 60° from a target of loosely bound electrons is about:
(60° par bikhri X-rays ka Compton shift taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The factor h/m₀c has dimensions of wavelength and is called Compton wavelength and has the numerical value

blocks.prompt:
